description.ja: 『フルメタル・パニック！ Invisible Victory』11話12話で大活躍した、ウルズチームの漆黒の隊長機「M9Dファルケ」を一部新規金型で立体化！
description.en: "Full Metal Panic! Invisible Victory's jet-black captain machine " M9D Falke ", which played a big role in episodes 11 and 12 of " Invisible Victory", is now three-dimensional with some new molds!

description.ja: • 頭部、肩部、脚部パーツは新規金型で造形。新規オリジナル武器も付属。
description.en: • The head, shoulders, and leg parts are sculpted using new molds. New original weapons are also included.

description.ja: • M9Dファルケの特徴的な単分子カッター「クリムゾンエッジ」が追加武装として付属。
description.en: • M9D Falke's characteristic single molecule cutter "Crimson Edge" is included as an additional weapon.

description.ja: • 別売りのHG1/60 アーバレストVer.IV（緊急展開ブースター装備仕様）の緊急展開ブースターを装備できる。
description.en: • Can be equipped with the emergency deployment booster of the separately sold HG1/60 Arbalest Ver.IV (Equipped with emergency deployment booster).

accessories.ja: グラーツ・マンリッヒャーAWS2000×1
